title: Optimal Alternating Regret for Online Learning and Games
abstract: arXiv:2608.24731v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We settle the minimax-optimal alternating regret, a regret notion motivated by alternating learning dynamics in games, for both online linear optimization (OLO) and online convex optimization (OCO).   For OLO over the probability simplex $\Delta_d$, we give an algorithm with $O(\log d)$ alternating regret that remains a constant for any time horizon $T$, and a matching lower bound. Our constant regret bound significantly improves previous results with $O(\log ^{2/3}d \cdot T^{1/3})$ regret [Cevher, Cutkosky, Kavis, Piliouras, Skoulakis, Viano, NeurIPS 2023, Hait, Li, Luo, Zhang, COLT 2025]. As a result, we obtain alternating learning dynamics with $O(\log d /T)$ convergence to Nash equilibria in two-player zero-sum games and $O(\log d /T)$ convergence to coarse correlated equilibria in two-player general-sum games. translated_title: 在线学习与博弈中的最优交替遗憾
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24731v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们解决了在线线性优化（OLO）和在线凸优化（OCO）中的极小极大最优交替遗憾问题，这一遗憾概念源于博弈中的交替学习动态。对于概率单纯形上的OLO，我们给出了一种具有O(log d)交替遗憾的算法，该遗憾在任何时间范围T内保持常数，并匹配了相应的下界。我们的常数遗憾界显著改进了先前的结果，后者具有O(log^{2/3}d · T^{1/3})的遗憾[Cevher, Cutkosky, Kavis, Piliouras, Skoulakis, Viano, NeurIPS 2023, Hait, Li, Luo, Zhang, COLT 2025]。因此，我们获得了在两人零和博弈中以O(log d /T)收敛到纳什均衡的交替学习动态，以及在两人一般和博弈中以O(log d /T)收敛到粗相关均衡的交替学习动态。这是首次在两人一般和博弈中实现O(1/T)收敛到CCE的非耦合学习动态，而所有先前的方法...
tldr: 本文首次实现了在线线性优化和在线凸优化中交替遗憾的极小极大最优常数界，并由此获得了两人一般和博弈中首个O(1/T)收敛到粗相关均衡的非耦合学习动态。
en_tdlr: This paper achieves the minimax-optimal constant alternating regret for online linear and convex optimization, yielding the first uncoupled learning dynamics with O(1/T) convergence to coarse correlated equilibria in two-player general-sum games.
